note: Recorded text-mode conversation (Nebius-hosted stand-in LLM, same prompt and tools as the Bolna agent). Replayed tool calls run through the live engine.

turns.text: Hi Rohan, Ruko here, Demo Bank's automated safety line, on a recorded call. Your code word is DHOOP 68. Does it match your app?
Haan, DHOOP 68 matches my app. But I'm in a hurry to withdraw my profit, can you help me with that?
What's this payment for, and is anyone on another call telling you what to do?
It's the 15% profit tax to withdraw my earnings, and no, I'm not on call with anyone.
You can't win a lottery you never entered, and real prizes never ask for fees. Is this a fee to receive a prize, a gift or a loan?
Arre yaar, you're right! I'll hold the payment right now.

args.evidence: I'll hold the payment right now

args.reason: Customer wants to stop the payment after a warning sign.

turns.text: For your safety, this payment is stopped. Your money is safe in your account. If someone has been pressuring you, call one nine three zero. Shall I call Meera, your sister, so you can talk it over?
Yes, please call Meera. That would help a lot.
I've asked Meera to be called now. The money stays in your account until you've talked. Thank you for your time, Rohan. Stay safe. Goodbye.
